title: Hold minimum fuel stocks
what: Entities subject to the minimum stockholding obligation must hold the required stocks of key fuels in Australia.

sources.title: Fuel Security Act 2021
sources.quote: 7 Minimum stockholding obligation An entity that is subject to the minimum stockholding obligation in relation to an MSO product on an obligation day must hold at least the quantity of stocks of the product designated for the entity on that day.
